summary: A man allegedly sexually harassed a visiting tourist and tore her dress during the night. One man was accused of committing the offence. The incident took place in Thiruvananthapuram district. Police registered a criminal case and arrested the accused with the help of video footage. The accused will be produced before a court for remand while further investigation continues.
title: Police arrest man for sexually harassing tourist in Kerala
verification_note: The reported sexual harassment incident in Varkala, Kerala matches the details provided in the source.

summary: In September 2026, four people were arrested in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala for the child sexual offence. A special investigation team was formed. An FIR has been filed. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Child sexual offence — Thiruvananthapuram (2026) — FIR filed
